rationale: An immutable controller policy is a stated, durable campaign concept. The existing name is established domain vocabulary and clearly owns the controller timing, reserve, heartbeat, and attempt bounds.
alternatives: Make the field required when a plan becomes executable; do not supply a production default.
Do not merge it into recovery_policy: recovery behavior and controller operation are distinct concerns.
simplestChoice: Keep controller_policy as a typed ControllerPolicy object on CampaignPlan.
